errors.text_span: започва на стойност около 2,0% през 2006 г.
errors.evidence: The line starts at approximately 2.5% in 2006, not 2.0%.
The peak in 2008 is significantly higher than 5.0%, at approximately 5.7%.
The description omits the sharp drop in the line from the 2008 peak to approximately 0.9% in 2009, as well as the subsequent recovery and plateau in 2010-2011.
The value in 2012 is a local peak at approximately 2.6%, not 2.0%.
The value in 2013 is approximately 1.8%, not 1.0%.
The description omits the entire period from 2014 to 2018, which includes the line reaching its minimum value of approximately -0.5% in 2015 before rising again.
The final value in 2019 is approximately 1.6%, not 2.0%.
